g.text: CONNECTIONS WITH HEIGHT / geometry-derived shared edges

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle

g.text: Circles = floor; squares = ramp. Labels Fxx / Y in WU (Alpha half). Lines are shared-edge adjacency, not walking chords through rooms.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle

g.text: Every seam coordinate, clear width and endpoint height is listed in connections.csv. A projected crossing alone never creates an edge.
